verdict.confidence_scope: English mapped name attached to the entire generalized source/baseline lake polygon.
verdict.rationale: Complete-shape inspection, a coordinate-framed federal map, and two regional territorial maps agree on Buffalo Lake. The geographically separate Tathlina candidate is excluded.

candidate_lead_handling: Candidate names require independent checks against complete geometry and surrounding named waters. Neither lead nor a nearby point is identity evidence by itself.

candidate_comparison.discrimination: The entire target falls east of 116°W and west of 115°W, just north of 60°N. The map labels the corresponding full basin Buffalo Lake. The long western body, enlarged northeastern end and southern lobe all correspond.
Regional maps place this separately named lake west of Enterprise and west of 117°W; the adjoining-sheet inset puts it on 85C rather than the target’s 85B. It is a different lake.

baseline.historical_deployment_relation: Recovered 2026-10-08 README and summary report this manifest equal to the then-observed deployment. Reused immutable repository assets match those retained historical hashes.

coordinate_checks.inspection: Whole exterior ring and coordinate-labeled overview inspected, with original source and decoded baseline compared without removing vertices or rings.
coordinate_checks.not_tested: Full OGC topology and surveyed shoreline equivalence.

geometry_lineage.complete_geometry_definition: All source/baseline rings and vertices retained, including closure. Completeness is relative to this generalized Natural Earth-derived representation, not all physical shoreline/island detail.

map_match_scope.method: Manual coordinate-graticule and complete-outline comparison, cross-checked by regional neighbor relationships. No quantitative georeferencing or pixel-overlap statistic was computed.

remaining_gaps: Formal contemporary name-register entry and naming decision date were not established.
No direct Korean-name evidence was acquired; Korean remains null. Indigenous-language naming and aliases were not evaluated.
The source has one exterior ring and no holes. Its simplification cannot substantiate exact shores, islands, narrow connections or seasonal water boundaries.
The older federal sheet uses NAD27; no datum transformation or surveyed-boundary overlay was performed.
The live deployment was not checked. FIDs and logical FIDs refer only to the pinned baseline.
bounded_conclusion: The name conflict is resolved for this generalized feature. Precision shoreline and formal-registry claims remain unverified; no name is automatically applied.
